Digital Lock with a 2-Digit PIN Code
A smart cabinet lock opens only if the correct 2-digit PIN (00–99) is entered.
The total number of possible combinations is 10 × 10 = 100 possible combinations
For a 2-digit numeric code it is possible to run 100 automated tests to ensure the system never accepts an incorrect code combination.
